data.title: 三司绫濑 · 海景露台的冰饮偷闲
data.description: 午后白色太阳伞在海景度假露台上撑出一片清凉，绫濑斜靠在藤编躺椅里，手里轻摇插着吸管的冰镇桃子苏打。珊瑚粉褶皱抹胸泳装与轻盈网纱泳裙衬得她明艳灵动，她趁四下无人悄悄舒了口气，笑言这才是真正属于自己的假期。
data.location: 面向湛蓝海面的白色太阳伞度假露台
data.action: 斜靠藤编躺椅手持冷饮吸管，放松轻笑望向海面
data.lighting: 伞下清凉柔光与栏杆外耀眼碧海日光交相辉映
data.camera: 四分之三中景，展现度假露台与轻快色彩
data.mood: 轻松、明媚、卸下包袱的惬意
promptTokens: holding iced peach soda with straw
data.promptProse: Relaxing in a rattan lounge chair beneath a white sun parasol on an oceanfront terrace, Ayase holds a frosted glass of peach soda with a striped straw. Sunlight sparkles off the turquoise water behind her coral-pink ruffled bandeau bikini and mesh swim skirt as she shares an unguarded summer smile.
data.animaCaption: Relaxed in a shaded terrace lounge chair overlooking the ocean, she holds an iced peach soda with an easy smile.
